digest.component_or_area: plan review, criterion routing, Pass-1 container analysis
propositions: Plan review certified epics with mutually unsatisfiable acceptance criteria across parent and children without detecting the contradiction, surfacing it only later during implementation or verification.

No existing criterion owns within-ticket acceptance-criteria satisfiability; COH disclaims it, E1 and F1 cover different facets, and Pass-2's internal_conflict axis exists but Pass-1 has no upstream gate.
G3 cannot audit whether siblings cover parent ACs because its roster carries only ids and titles, not the acceptance-criteria items needed to discharge the no-sibling-covers-it test.

The sibling roster expression is duplicated across three independent callers (pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, eval_solver.py), causing divergence in what reaches the finder and corrupting dogfooding data for G3's deferred posture decision.
The roster is sent redundantly once per pairing in instructions instead of once in a byte-stable prefix, preventing caching and growing quadratically with child count.
The roster's token cost is not included in parent_tokens estimates that feed bin-packing and the warm-cache gate, risking budget overruns.
